card.title: How To Fix iPhone 14 Not Charging due to open i2c line at battery connector

source.title: How To Fix iPhone 14 Not Charging due to open i2c line at battery connector

claims.statement: iPhone 14 that powers on but won't charge can have an open I2C2_SMC_CHARGER_BI_GG_SDA_1V8 line at the battery connector; it should read about 0.350 in diode mode, not OL.
Fix by tracing to a test point/via on the opposite side with the correct reading and running a fine jumper to the battery connector pin.

procedure: Rule out cable, brick and dock flex.
Diode-check the SDA pin at the battery connector (~0.350).
Check continuity to its opposite-side pad.
Jumper from the good point to the pin; check for shorts.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
